name: portal-andina
description: Portal Andina · repositorio de práctica del curso Desarrollo de software asistido por IA (Edutin Academy). Empresas y datos ficticios.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
